title: Implement bounded alias-table construction

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 bounded-alias-table capability assessment for the exact current source forest
scope.implementation_delta: No current-head Python package constructs a bounded PCSM alias table. PCSM-014 defines only the receipt-bound local-alias-to-canonical-CID boundary; PCSM-043 records that no optimizer selects aliases; PCSM-044 records that no natural-anchor retention policy decides retained-versus-aliased names. The existing supervisor token ledger provides deterministic, versioned provider/tokenizer accounting and DoctorReviewedTheorem provides deterministic theorem-body integrity, but neither accepts a canonical PCSM slice, enforces an alias-table cardinality or grammar bound, resolves alias collisions, emits alias-to-canonical entries, or binds a table to a PCSM source map. Exact declared-output authority excludes the missing source and test paths, so this receipt records an honest non-promotion/unavailable disposition rather than creating an untested competing implementation.

It has no PCSM slice or source-map input, alias candidate set, finite table bound, collision rule, deterministic alias allocation, table output, or local-alias-to-canonical relinking.
